description: This Java source file defines the immutable data object 'SavingsAccountData' representing a savings account in the Apache Fineract project. It includes numerous fields, constructors, and methods for managing and constructing savings account related data, including account properties, transactions, charges, options, and metadata. The class supports various factory methods for different use cases such as importing instances for individuals or groups, and setting template options.
